summary: Iter-18 verified all 3 P0 demo blockers + 1 enhancement for tomorrow's investor/customer demo. (1) Bulk Upload: [data-testid=bulk-file-input] has `multiple` + accept='.csv,.jsonl,.txt,.json,.md'; selecting 2 files shows '2 files selected' indicator, concatenates with `=== ` separator, filenames embedded as '# FILE: <name>', backend bulk-upload endpoint returns scored>=2 on ===-separated payload AND single-file still works. (2) Executive Live/Demo toggle: DEMO shows hardcoded Pricing/Poor Support/Product/Competitor/Technical + Small Business/Mid-Market/Enterprise/Startup; clicking [data-testid=mode-live] swaps to real DB-derived data — top-reasons array and segments array BOTH visibly change (Enterprise disappears because DB has no Enterprise customers, only Mid-Market/Small Business/Startup), churn-tile changes 8.2%->12.5%. (3) Settings: /dashboard/settings renders all 5 tabs (ai, integrations, notify, quality, security), reset-defaults-btn + save-settings-btn present, UI save triggers PUT /api/settings -> 200. Backend GET /api/settings returns nested ai_keys/integrations/notifications/quality/security with sensible defaults; PUT persists and GET reflects. (4) Watch 60-second demo: [data-testid=watch-demo-btn] visible on landing hero, click opens [data-testid=demo-video-modal] with <video data-testid=demo-video-player> pointing at /video/retops-demo.mp4 (HTTP 200, 2.81MB, video/mp4), ESC closes, backdrop click closes, footer [data-testid=demo-video-book] -> https://link.quicklyster.ca/widget/booking/... . Regression: email/password login still 200, no 'Emergent' text leaks on /, /dashboard/executive, /dashboard/settings, /dashboard/bulk, /dashboard/coaching. Backend pytest: 9/9 pass in iter18_settings.xml.

minor.issue: SettingsIn model requires llm_provider + llm_model as non-optional (422 if omitted). Frontend always sends them via DEFAULTS merge, so no user-facing impact, but partial/patch updates from third-party clients would 422. Consider making them Optional or adding a PATCH route.

issues: React dev-time hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered by the retention_days <select>. Root cause is emergent dev-instrumentation wrapping dynamic JSX in <span style=display:contents>; harmless at runtime (select still works, PUT still persists 270/365), but spams console. Should disappear in production build.

action_items: Consider making SettingsIn.llm_provider/llm_model Optional[str] = None OR add PATCH /api/settings — avoids 422 for partial updates (non-blocking for demo since UI always sends full payload).
Carry-over from iter-12/14: brute-force lockout still broken behind K8s ingress (request.client.host per-pod). Not re-tested in iter-18; fix with X-Forwarded-For parsing.
Optional: Settings <select> option warning — wrap option text children in plain string vs instrumented JSX if dev warning noise is a concern.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoVideoModal.jsx: video is autoPlay+muted which browsers allow, but `object-cover` will crop a 16:9 recording on 16:9 aspect container — consider object-contain so the walkthrough is never cropped.

BulkUpload handleFiles: 25MB combined check happens AFTER setFiles but BEFORE read — correct. However the word-count indicator recomputes on every keystroke with split(/\s+/) on a potentially 25MB string — throttle or memoize if users paste large CSVs.
ExecutiveView dataMode toggle re-derives reasons/segments inline via IIFE (lines 217-284) on every render; consider useMemo keyed on (dataMode, liveChurn) — minor perf, not blocking.

server.py SettingsIn requires llm_provider+llm_model (pre-existing API contract) while new fields are optional — OK for full-payload save but breaks forward-compat for partial updates. Recommend Optional[str] with default 'openai'/'gpt-4o-mini'.
Settings.jsx is 425 lines with inline PasswordField/NumField/SelectField + 5 tab components — OK for now but consider per-tab file split before hitting ~700.
